description: A German remote-sensing team publishes a ten-metre grid of estimated building heights for Germany. Zenodo provides the map archive under CC BY 4.0. Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 time series were used with machine-learning regression, trained against official 3D building-model references. The reference height represents an average around each pixel, and prediction was limited to pixels identified as built-up. This map can estimate urban form and building exposure for flood, wind and heat simulations. Related catalogue data-3d-globfp-global-3d-building-footprints provides a distinct footprint-level global product. Coverage is Germany using satellite inputs mainly from 2017–2018 and reference building data from 2012–2020, not a 2026 asset register. A limitation is that the source years differ and predictions below two metres were set to zero; individual structures and local redevelopment can be misrepresented. No raster was downloaded, and neither map accuracy nor projection was checked.
